periodPublication.title: Four Years in British Columbia and Vancouver Island
periodPublication.author: Richard Charles Mayne
periodPublication.visualComparison: The published engraving matches the composition and architecture in the Qualla watercolor, including the tall lower octagonal log storey, projecting gun floor, steep faceted roof, high palisade on the right, the sloped small gabled building, the two-storey house behind the left tree and the prominent foreground rock. The engraving reworks minor detail and tones.
periodPublication.artistDocumentation: The University of Victoria thesis identifies figure 24 as BC Archives pdp2893 and attributes the Mayne blockhouse engraving to a Crease sketch in the archives. The Dictionary of Canadian Biography independently identifies the same dated Crease watercolor.
